title: Norfolk Southern helps build the next generation of engineers at University of Georgia
body_markdown:
[The University of Georgia College of Engineering](https://engineering.uga.edu/) celebrated the naming of the Norfolk Southern Student Organization Hub within Driftmier Engineering Center on Monday, October 26. Made possible by a $100,000 contribution from Norfolk Southern, the space gives engineering student club leaders a dedicated place to connect, collaborate, and develop skills for their future careers.


**Top Takeaway**


- NS’ investment supported the 23 student clubs and organizations within the College of Engineering by providing a dedicated workspace for student organization officers and members to coordinate projects, hold meetings, and collaborate across engineering disciplines.


**Creating space for future engineers**


Located in[UGA's Driftmier Engineering Center](https://engineering.uga.edu/venue/driftmier-1240/) , the Norfolk Southern Student Organization Hub is designed to bring engineering students together and strengthen the college's student community.


The space supports 23 student organizations, including:


- [National Society of Black Engineers](https://nsbe.uga.edu/) (NSBE)
- [Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers](https://shpe.org/engage/programs/) (SHPE)
- [Society of Asian Scientists and Engineers](https://www.instagram.com/sase_uga/) (SASE)
- [Society of Women Engineers](https://www.instagram.com/swe_uga/) (SWE)


Through student-led activities, collaboration, and professional development, these organizations will help students build connections and gain experience beyond the classroom.


**What they're saying**


"Investing in the Student Organization Hub is an investment in workforce development. By giving engineering students a place to collaborate, share ideas, and grow as leaders, we're helping them build the skills they'll need to succeed in their careers and shape the future of engineering." - Kristin Wong, Director, Norfolk Southern Foundation & Community Impact


“Norfolk Southern has been a fantastic partner to the university and the college,” said Alex Orso, Dean, UGA College of Engineering. “This dedicated space for our student organizations is a great representation of their support of the engineering leaders of tomorrow.”


**The big picture**


Engineers play an important role in building safer, smarter, and more sustainable railroads. By supporting hands-on learning, leadership, and collaboration at UGA, Norfolk Southern helped prepare the next generation of talent to take on tomorrow's challenges.


[Learn more](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/commitments/in-your-community/community-impact) about Norfolk Southern's community impact efforts.
